description: Founded in 2007, Montréal Sauna Inc. is a Sauna distributor for Tropical Saunas located in California USA. We are proud to provide high quality infrared sauna to our customers all over Canada. Our goal is to provide the best health product, the far infrared sauna to our customers in the province of Quebec and all over Canada. We are determined and dedicated to satisfy our customer’s needs.  Montréal Sauna is the places to purchase the best quality saunas in the industry. For your health benefits or just to relax and feel good, Montréal Sauna will surely offer a perfect Sauna for you.
